## Tailwind Classes

When writing Tailwind CSS classes, use the following guidelines:
- Use `bg-surface-`, `text-ink-`, `border-outline-` classes for semantic colors.

## Vue

When writing Vue components, follow these guidelines:
- Use the following structure for importing icons:
    ```js
    import LucidePlus from '~icons/lucide/plus';
    ```
- Use the following structure for using icons directly in templates, no import needed:
    ```vue
    <LucidePlus class="h-4 w-4" />
    ```

## Python

When writing python code in a frappe project, use the following guidelines:
- Use frappe-bench/env/bin/python3 to run and test python scripts.
